Looking for a car stereo with a built-in CD player? There are still good aftermarket options from brands like Pioneer, Kenwood, and JVC.

The main thing to look for is a CD receiver, rather than a digital media receiver (which doesn't play CDs).

Here are a few features worth considering:

Bluetooth: Stream music and make hands-free calls.

CD-R/CD-RW support: Play burned CDs as well as standard audio CDs.

USB input: Play music from a flash drive.

Single-DIN or double-DIN: Choose the size that fits your dashboard.
